headline: On October 28, 2023: South Africa wins 4th Webb Ellis Cup
captionCards: First time both finalists had lost a game in the tournament
instagramCaption:
South Africa defeats New Zealand in a thrilling final.\nIn the 2023 Rugby World Cup final at the Stade de France, South Africa narrowly beat New Zealand 12-11. This victory made South Africa the first nation to win four Webb Ellis Cups. Both teams had already lost a game during the tournament, making this a historic final.
